name: Consecrated Rune
summary: At Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner calls fledgling dwarven paladins to join the Knights of the Silver Hand. Sten Stoutarm summons them there.

sections.title: A Summons to Anvilmar
sections.body: Your rune marks the start of a formal induction, where raw potential must meet discipline. Around Coldridge Valley, local leaders watch for those gifted in divine martial prowess. Bromos Grummner awaits inside Anvilmar to guide new initiates.

sections.title: Dwarves and the Holy Light
sections.body: The Knights of the Silver Hand began among the humans of Lordaeron, yet Ironforge dwarves embraced the Holy Light with fierce devotion. Bromos welcomes you into the brotherhood and reminds you that dwarven paladins share the solemn duty of protecting Azeroth. The order is grounded in sacrifice, tradition, and martial virtue, and asks recruits to take up hammer and faith in equal measure.

faq.answer: The Consecrated Rune is an inscribed token Sten Stoutarm gives novice dwarven paladins in Coldridge Valley. It directs you to Bromos Grummner inside Anvilmar for formal training.
Bromos Grummner is the paladin trainer inside Anvilmar. He instructs new dwarven members of the Knights of the Silver Hand and prepares them for dangers threatening Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why are dwarves part of the Knights of the Silver Hand?
faq.answer: During the Second War and its aftermath, human priests and paladins brought the teachings of the Holy Light to Ironforge dwarves. Dwarves respect the order's martial discipline and willingness to sacrifice for Azeroth's defense.

faq.q: Who gives you the Consecrated Rune?
aliases: where do i get the rune
faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm gives you the rune outside Anvilmar after you help him with local tasks. He says Bromos Grummner asked him to deliver it.
Bromos Grummner is inside Anvilmar's great hall in Coldridge Valley, alongside the other class mentors.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the rune to Bromos?
faq.answer: After you present the rune, Bromos acknowledges your acceptance into the Silver Hand and offers your first formal combat and holy training. Then he sends you back into Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a paladin, this rune marks your first formal step into the Knights of the Silver Hand. Your duty is to channel the Light in defense of Ironforge.
As a dwarf, you bring traditional dwarven fortitude together with theology taught by humans. Dwarven paladins bring steadfast resolve to the teachings of the Holy Light.
